evidence: Isolated exact bundled-component npm audit returned this advisory.

proof_gaps: Complete lower-trust input/control/sink path for this individual advisory has not been demonstrated; no exploit claim or runtime validation is made.
findings.recommended_next_step: Preserve failed audit; qualify an exact fixed SDK artifact or reviewed upstream rebuild. Do not treat latest2.4.0 as complete remediation: published artifact still embeds3.1.8.
